summary: The filing reports The Children's Place, Inc. entering into a $15 million Shariah-compliant unsecured subordinated promissory note under its existing $40 million Mithaq Credit Facility. This is a routine debt draw, not a special situation. The funds were received on July 1, 2026, reducing remaining availability to $25 million. The note matures April 16, 2031, with interest at SOFR plus 9% per annum, subject to deferment. It is guaranteed by subsidiaries and subordinated to senior credit facilities. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is occurring.
